text:
nina-sales: AcadiaEdge POC kickoff. They want Redwood Private in their AWS account. Must egress via their TLS-inspect proxy, SOC requires original client IPs in request logs, and they need a very small static allowlist for this week's firewall change window. Can we give a preferred topology and a pasteable firewall entry?

chuck-net: Two practical topologies w/ tradeoffs:
1) PrivateLink (interface endpoint) -> Redwood-hosted connector: very low customer infra but endpoint ENI IPs are AZ-scoped and can change if re-created. If their proxy SNATs, we'll only see proxy IP unless it injects X-Forwarded-For.
2) Connector deployed in-customer VPC (NLB TCP passthrough + 2 EIPs) -> preferred for audit. NLB preserves client IP at TCP layer; provide 2 stable EIPs to SOC for allowlisting. Customer pays small infra but gains stable IPs.

adele-se: Quick TLS notes: ALB terminates TLS and hides source IP (use X-Forwarded-For). NLB preserves source IP; for mTLS terminate on connector and validate client certs. If probe requires Prom metrics, keep over 443 for the POC to avoid extra firewall rules.

mike-ps: Cost summary for procurement: PrivateLink = AWS endpoint hourly + per-GB processing; connector-in-VPC = EC2/NLB/EIP costs (we typically offer a short POC infra credit).

chuck-net: Pasteable firewall ticket (choose one):
Variant A - Connector-in-VPC (recommended):
Allow TCP/443 from App Subnet 10.60.0.0/22 to Connector NLB EIPs 198.51.100.150 and 198.51.100.151 (outbound).
Allow TCP/443 from Connector EIPs to App LB SG (inbound) for callback flows if needed.
Variant B - PrivateLink (if customer cannot host infra):
Allow TCP/443 from App Subnet 10.60.0.0/22 to Interface Endpoint ENI IPs (ENI IPs provided after endpoint creation; may change on re-create).
Also request: if your TLS proxy SNATs, configure it to forward X-Forwarded-For and avoid SNAT for these flows to preserve client IPs.

deploy-bot: Provisioned ephemeral POC connector stack in acct 222333444555 (us-east-1). id: acacia-poc-3412. NLB created, awaiting EIP allocation.

nina-sales: Owners: chuck-net -> final 1-page runbook + firewall entry (EOD); adele-se -> security Q lines for mTLS/KMS/log forwarding; mike-ps -> POC credit blurb for quote. One-liner for SOC ticket?

chuck-net: One-liner: "To preserve original client IPs use NLB TCP passthrough (recommended) or ensure your TLS proxy forwards X-Forwarded-For and does not SNAT these flows."
